sheets.row_guide: Top: five large two-story villa colorways (orange/brown/burgundy/red/blue roofs) with porch+balcony. Upper-mid: modular chimneys, round attic windows, roof windows, solar panels, wall props (sconces, plaques, shuttered windows), lemonade stands. Mid-right: toy/playhouses, basketball hoops, seesaws, spring riders, sandboxes. Mid-lower: trampolines, yard trees/stumps/flowers/bushes, stepping stones, logs, hanging flower boxes, potted plants, picket/rail fencing, EV bollards, armchairs. Lower band0 / band1 top: picnic blankets and picnic props (baskets, coolers, food). Band1 (y768–912): complete treehouse with tire swing, trunk+deck base, cabin module, ladders, picnic/toolbox blankets, bottle/fruit scatter.

sheets.row_guide: Top: dirt/grass path autotiles, pebbles, stones, bushes implied via flora, flower pots/groups, mushrooms, sprouts, clovers. Upper-mid: grey/brown/black stone crosses, small tombstones, marble markers, long tombstones, stone gates/arches (plain + red-orb) in big/high/medium/small sizes. Mid: open dirt ditches/graves, wood plank vertical graves, dirt piles with/without shovel or cross, candles and holders. Mid-lower: Grace Chapel mausoleums (open + gated), grave cage, leafless dead trees (bare + pumpkin-faced with hanging lanterns), trunk face module. Bottom: squared stone sarcophagi (closed/open/lids/skeleton/skull/ribcage variants), fancy red/silver/yellow coffins, bones/skeleton/skull, crows (4 poses), jack-o'-lanterns in many sizes/colors including hanging branch pumpkins.
